versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ym-review-triage-reply.
- Classifies negative reviews, suggests if private follow-up is needed, and drafts three versions of accountable replies (standard, short, and private).
- Provides actionable improvement suggestions based on review content.
- Covers edge cases, ability boundaries, and common pitfalls clearly in documentation.
- Requires no third-party dependencies or platform integration; processes all input via plain text.
